title: RepoEntry (with injectAgents)
description: A single repository entry in project.json repos[]. Extended with the optional injectAgents opt-in flag for agent-docs injection targeting.

path.description: Repository path; resolved to absolute against the config directory at runtime.

name.description: Optional kebab-case logical name; derived from basename(path) when omitted. Must be unique across repos.

provides.description: Package names this repo provides (cross-repo symbol resolution).

injectAgents.description: When true, this repo is an agent-docs injection target. Absent/null is treated as false (opt-in only). Legacy targetProjectPath configs have no repos[] and are implicitly opted-in. Non-indexed targets are configured separately via the top-level agentInjectionTargets array (string[]).
